subject: integration
name: Load from the site owner's record
summary: A load-order switch. On, the contenthash a name's owner published is tried through the rows of its type, in the person's order; Off, it is skipped. It asks no standard code, runs nothing and connects to nothing: the record comes from the name's resolver and each row that loads it is judged on its own row. It calls a load unchecked only for a web server without a DDOC record or a record a node or resolver did not prove; a contenthash naming a DNS name (read over an unauthenticated DNSLink) or an IPNS name (newest record unproven) still counts as checked, so not 4. Judged here by its publisher.
